issues.spec_citation: CQL Reference v1.5.3 Appendix B, Comparison Operators / Equivalent: equivalent returns true when both arguments are null and false for one-null cases; Interval Operators / Equivalent defines interval equivalence through Start/End equivalence.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe across forced Python fallback, native-loaded registration, and no-Python C++ showed no-Python intervalEquivalent(NULL, NULL) and one-null variants propagated SQL NULL while Python/native returned CQL equivalence booleans.
issues.root_cause: The no-Python C++ registration used a null-propagating macro wrapper for intervalEquivalent, so SQL NULL inputs were never interpreted using CQL equivalence rules.
issues.resolution: Replaced the generated wrapper with an explicit null-aware IntervalEquivalentFunc: both NULL arguments return true, exactly one NULL argument returns false, and parsed intervals continue through semantic interval equality/equivalence.
issues.verified_in: CQL-16 HISTORIAN iteration 1: focused parity pytest 4 passed; interval/browser cluster 81 passed; native C++ sqllogictest 718 assertions passed; official conformance 2822/2822; full pytest 7200 passed, 5 skipped.

issues.spec_citation: CQL Reference v1.5.3 Appendix B, Date/DateTime partial precision comparison semantics and Interval Operators / Included In, Meets, On Or After/Before, Overlaps: interval relationships use Start/End semantics and temporal comparisons at the requested precision; imprecise operands may yield null.
issues.evidence: Fresh probes showed partial temporal uncertainty collapsing to false: no-Python intervalOverlapsPrecise and intervalIncludedIn over year-only interval bounds diverged from Python/native NULL; translated Interval[@2014, @2014] overlaps day of Interval[@2014-06-01, @2014-06-02] decomposed to raw string comparisons.
issues.root_cause: C++ interval JSON string bounds were parsed through generic string/numeric classification, so year-only temporal bounds became numeric-looking values in interval contexts. The translator also applied precision overlap decomposition without a static under-precision check, while an initial runtime CQLPrecision guard over all bounds proved too broad and regressed DQM.
issues.resolution: Added interval-bound temporal parsing for Date/DateTime/Time-looking strings, added precision-aware point parsing for intervalContainsPrecise, routed point included-in precision through intervalContainsPrecise, and constrained translated overlap uncertainty folding to static partial temporal interval literals while preserving the DQM day-window decomposition for dynamic/resource intervals.
